paragraphs.text: 1. THE Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness.
paragraphs.original: चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेने अजनन्नम्नमाने ।
paragraphs.translit: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannamnamāne |

paragraphs.text: Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.
2. Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence.
paragraphs.original: विश्वकर्मा विमना आद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत संदृक् ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk |

paragraphs.text: Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One, beyond the Seven Rsis.
paragraphs.original: तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तऋषीन्पर एकमाहुः
paragraphs.translit: teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā saptaṛṣīnpara ekamāhuḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing,
paragraphs.original: यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā |

paragraphs.text: Even he alone, the Deities' name-giver, him other beings seek for information.
paragraphs.original: यो देवानां नामधा एक एव तं सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या
paragraphs.translit: yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā

paragraphs.text: 4. To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,-Rsis of old, in numerous troops, as singers,
paragraphs.original: त आयजन्त द्रविणं समस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना ।
paragraphs.translit: ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā |

paragraphs.text: Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.
paragraphs.original: असूर्ते सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि
paragraphs.translit: asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni

paragraphs.text: 5. That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and Gods had being,-
paragraphs.original: परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti |

paragraphs.text: What was the germ primeval which the waters received where all the Gods were seen together?
paragraphs.original: कं स्विद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त विश्वे
paragraphs.translit: kaṃ svidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve

paragraphs.text: 6. The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together.
paragraphs.original: तमिद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve |

paragraphs.text: It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.
7. Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you.
paragraphs.original: न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानान्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव ।
paragraphs.translit: na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva |

paragraphs.text: Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters wander and are discontented.
